## 📦 Installation

Each template includes:
- ✅ Complete source code
- ✅ Development environment setup
- ✅ Build scripts
- ✅ Documentation
- ✅ Live preview capability

```bash
# Clone template (example)
git clone https://github.com/hanzo-apps/template-synapse.git

# Install dependencies
cd template-synapse
npm install

# Run development server
npm run dev
```

## 🌐 Deployment Options

- **Hanzo Cloud** - One-click deployment
- **Vercel** - Next.js optimized
- **Netlify** - JAMstack friendly
- **GitHub Pages** - Static sites
- **Custom** - Any hosting provider
